problem: A release/source digest can be correct while CPython executes different cached or sourceless bytecode; source identity and executable-byte identity are separate claims.

observed_f2_boundary.positive: archive digest, manifest digest, source commit/tree and build-id are bound

hypothesis: F2 should distinguish RELEASE_SOURCE_SUBJECT from PYTHON_EXECUTED_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT before runtime-subject closure.
counterhypothesis: The exact F2 launcher may already exclude divergent cached/sourceless bytecode or directly bind consumed executable artifacts; inspect before implementation.
proposed_delta: Bind the actually consumed Python executable artifact, or prove and receipt an execution policy excluding stale/sourceless bytecode divergence; preserve all existing archive/source checks.
falsifier_for_delta: If exact F2 launcher evidence proves unchecked/sourceless bytecode cannot be selected and that invariant is evidence-bound, reject this gate as redundant.
scope: research candidate only; no F2 runtime/host/effect/whole-system credit
